sources.entry: TÂCHES Claude Code Resources by TÂCHES - A well-balanced, "down-to-Earth" set of sub agents, skills, and commands, that are well-organized, easy to read, and a healthy focus on "meta"-skills/agents, like "skill-auditor", hook creation, etc. - the kind of things you can adapt to your workflow, and not the other way around.

summary.one_liner: A collection of custom Claude Code slash commands, skills, and auditor subagents for meta-prompting, planning, todo capture, thinking frameworks, and debugging.
summary.what_it_does: The repo bundles 27 slash commands, 9 skills, and 3 auditor agents for Claude Code. Commands include meta-prompting (/create-prompt, /run-prompt), todo capture and resume (/add-to-todos, /check-todos), handoff documents (/whats-next), and twelve "/consider:*" thinking frameworks such as first principles, inversion, and 5-whys. Skills cover building other Claude Code extensions: agent skills, slash commands, subagents, hooks, and MCP servers in Python or TypeScript. A plan-oriented skill (create-plans) produces hierarchical BRIEF/ROADMAP/PLAN files, and setup-ralph sets up Geoffrey Huntley's Ralph autonomous coding loop. Auditor subagents (skill-auditor, slash-command-auditor, subagent-auditor) review extensions against best practices.
use_cases: Install reusable slash commands and skills into Claude Code
Plan a solo software project with Claude in phased plan files
Capture ideas mid-session and resume tasks later
Create new skills, subagents, slash commands, or hooks
Audit existing Claude Code skills or agent configurations
Apply structured thinking frameworks to decisions
Run a systematic debugging session with hypothesis testing
how_to_run: Manual: git clone the repo, then cp -r commands/* ~/.claude/commands/
Start a new Claude Code session to load commands and skills
notable: Meta-skills for building Claude Code extensions, including skill-auditor and hook creation
Twelve /consider thinking-model commands for decisions and problem analysis
create-plans skill designed for solo developer plus Claude, with context handoff at low token budget and git commits of outcomes
Setup Ralph skill for Geoffrey Huntley's autonomous coding loop
caveats: create-plans references expertise skills (5k-10k+ lines) that the user must author themselves via create-agent-skills
Some features are described as 'see separate README' and the main README gives only summaries
README says 'More resources coming soon', so the collection is still growing
keywords: plan a software project with ai
